title: Following a chain of offsets
hints: Keep the current position as a `const unsigned char*` so that adding an offset moves by bytes. To read the pointer stored at `at + offset`, `std::memcpy` 8 bytes from there into a `const void*`.
The players array starts at `offsetof(World, players)`, and player `i`'s pointer is `i * sizeof(Player*)` bytes further on. So the chain from a `Game` is: world, that slot, stats, health.
